name: Kellogg's Corn Flakes Original Cereal
whyItWorks: Milled from degermed corn grit (which completely strips away the dangerous indigestible outer corn hull). The paper-thin toasted flakes soften within seconds of touching liquid, leaving no roughage behind.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Pour cold lactose-free milk over the flakes and let them soak for 30 seconds for a gentle, easy-to-swallow breakfast.
watchOuts: Completely hull-free; safe for strictures unlike whole sweet corn.
